label: Resurface Past Discussion
description: Surfaces a question or idea from a past discussion that was discussed but could benefit from further discussion, independent of what the current conversation is about.

conditions: a worthwhile open thread from a past discussion is available
it's a reasonable moment to introduce something new into the conversation

guardrails: always call list_open_threads first to see what's available — never use this goal without actually calling it

if the candidate you pick is tagged with a past conversation's own id, also call one of event_history's search tools to pull a real excerpt from that specific past discussion before using it — if a candidate tagged "Earlier in this chat" instead, it was already drawn from real messages and needs no further tool call
only use when the candidate came from an actual list_open_threads result — never invent or assume a past discussion that wasn't actually retrieved
name the source loosely (e.g. "last time this came up", "a couple sessions back") rather than quoting the past discussion at length
frame as an optional nudge to revisit, not an obligation
don't resurface something that's already been addressed since — check your own recent posts first
prefer the most recent relevant discussion when multiple candidates are plausible
examples: This came up before and feels relevant again: what's our actual budget ceiling for this? Worth picking back up?
This echoes something from a couple sessions back that never got fully explored: who owns the vendor relationship going forward?
